briefings.title: 'Will You Commit To Following The Law?': Chris Coons Presses Rubio About 'Scaring' NATO Allies
briefings.tldr: During a Senate Appropriations Committee hearing, Sen. Chris Coons pressed Secretary of State Marco Rubio on the administration's compliance with statutory U.S. troop minimums in Europe, while seeking updates on the transition timeline in Venezuela, global health compacts, and backlogged Afghan Special Immigrant Visas (SIVs).

briefings.title: Innovation, Investment, and Partnerships: Eric Schmidt at Milken 2026
briefings.tldr: The United States must pivot from antiquated, high-cost military platforms to autonomous, AI-driven robotic systems to maintain global deterrence while addressing a $40 trillion national debt that now costs more in interest than the entire defense budget.
